audit.meaning: Audit acceptance does not convert reference mismatches into published-output agreement.

control.method: Solve the unmodified original native source FEMM model independently of the source-reconstruction compiler; use a locally authored postprocessor script. No downloaded script was executed.

reference_discrepancy.causal_status: Unresolved. Original-source and reconstructed models agree on the current native engine, but both differ from the article energy and inductance. Possible engine, meshing, or source-model/version differences need further study; the evidence does not establish which cause is responsible.
reference_discrepancy.presentation: Individual EI reports retain failed published inductance and energy checks. A green audit means native checks and the reviewed original-source regression passed, not that every paper target passed.

original_source_regression_checks.meaning: Regression comparison only; published reference remains failed.
Regression comparison only; published reference remains failed.

protocol.purpose: Freeze official FEMM gapped-EI and nonlinear eight-pole-bearing input conditions, published targets, and controlled sensitivity expectations before running new native solutions.
protocol.code_tuning_policy: Do not adjust geometry, materials, boundary conditions or target tolerances to fit results. Preserve failed reports. Any corrected transcription creates a new protocol revision and discloses the original result.
protocol.source_policy: Use existing passively parsed native FEMM source assets as geometric and physical data. Reconstruct through allowlisted documented native calls; do not execute downloaded scripts.

published_targets.precision_note: Published result rounded to three significant digits.

published_targets.measurement: Weighted stress tensor mo_blockintegral(19) on lower I-return iron

cross_checks.scope: linear materials and finite A=0 boundary; all regions included in energy integral

inherited_source_differences: The 1.39mH reluctance calculation is only an approximate sanity check and is not the numerical target. Published finite-element inductance1.73mH incorporates leakage and fringing.
The prose box dimensions2in by2.5in correspond to source x-span2.5in and y-span2in; preserve coordinate orientation.
18AWG conductor source has conductivity58MS/m,LamType3,one1.02396529684335mmstrand; preserve its full source definition even inDC.

variations.name: mesh_refinement
variations.expected: Report all L,W,F results and successive changes with boundary fixed. Accept mesh independence only when last refinement changes each target metric less than1%; this is not an assertion of monotonic convergence.

published_targets.precision_note: Published400N is a rounded narrative result, not a high-precision numeric dataset.

Source native M19 LamFill1,d_lam0 versus nominal prose14mil laminations and0.98packing. Preserve native source material and report mismatch.
The source geometry is explicitly slightly adjusted from nominal dimensions, on the order1%; preserve exact native coordinates and arcs.
460N and6.4mH in design equations are preliminary circuit estimates;400N is the published finite-element force target.

limits: Agreement with published output and mesh independence are distinct measured checks. Both must be reported when studied.
These tests reproduce documented static FEMM examples; they do not validate rotor dynamics, feedback control, or arbitrary motor designs.
Targets are fixed before native runs. Numerical differences beyond tolerance are failures to investigate and preserve, not grounds to widen tolerance.
